correctness.rationale: At r=N, the environmental critical system has xdot=x(1-x)G and pdot=eps p(1-p)((theta+1)x-1). In the interior, pdot=0 forces x=a=1/(theta+1), while affine p-dependence and D<1<A give the unique p*. For N>=3 the gain f=G+1 has f_xx>0 and f(0,p*)=f(a,p*)=1, so G_x(a,p*)>0: the equilibrium is a source with positive trace/determinant. The strictly positive Dulac B=1/[x²(1-x)p(1-p)] has divergence [∫_0^x t f_xx(t,p)dt]/[x²p(1-p)]>0, excluding all interior cycles. Poincaré–Bendixson plus a unique hyperbolic source then forces every nonstationary trajectory to have boundary distance liminf zero, not necessarily convergence. For N=2 f_xx=0 and an exact coercive separated first integral makes every other interior level periodic. Exact N=3 example and signs checked.
